title: Calls, texts & voice notes
goal: Make and take calls, deal with bad signal and missed calls, text, send voice notes and your location, and say 'just', 'already', 'still' and 'not yet'.
intro:
Kannadigas call much more than they text: calls are cheap, and a two-minute call settles what would take twenty messages. When they do message, it's WhatsApp, often a **voice note**, and often in Kannada typed in English letters (*oota aytha?* 'have you eaten?').

This unit gives you the phone Kannada you'll use every day: **ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿದೆಯಾ?** 'can you hear me?', **ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಇಲ್ಲ**, **ಆಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ** 'I'll call you back', **ಲೊಕೇಶನ್ ಕಳಿಸು** 'send me the location'. Almost every phone word is English + **ಮಾಡು** (ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡು, ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಮಾಡು, ರಿಪ್ಲೈ ಮಾಡು).

The grammar is two things that make your Kannada flow: the **past participle** that chains actions ('I'll get home *and* call you', 'save my number *and* give me a missed call'), and the little time words **ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ** 'just', **ಆಗಲೇ** 'already', **ಇನ್ನೂ** 'still' and **ಇನ್ನೂ … ಇಲ್ಲ** 'not yet'.

vocab.note: ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡು 'to call' (= ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡು); ಕಾಲ್ ಬಂತು 'a call came'.

vocab.note: ಫೋನ್ ಎತ್ತು 'answer the phone'. Past ಎತ್ತಿದೆ. (ಎತ್ತು is also 'ox'.)
The hearer is in the dative: ನಿನಗೆ ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿದೆಯಾ? 'can you hear (me)?' (lit. is it audible to you?).
In chat often ವಾಯ್ಸ್ vāys.
ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಇಲ್ಲ 'no signal'. Also the traffic light (unit 23).
From ಸರಿ 'right'.
ಮಿಸ್ಡ್ ಕಾಲ್ ಕೊಡು 'give (someone) a missed call', a common signal: 'I've arrived', 'call me back'.
ಕಾಲ್ ಕಟ್ ಮಾಡು 'hang up (on purpose)'; ಕಾಲ್ ಕಟ್ ಆಯ್ತು 'the call dropped'.
ಫೋನ್ ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಆಫ್ ಆಗಿದೆ 'the phone is off'; ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಆಫ್ ಮಾಡು 'switch off'.
ಚಾರ್ಜ್ ಇಲ್ಲ 'no charge'; ಚಾರ್ಜಿಗೆ ಹಾಕು 'put on charge'.
ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಮಾಡು 'to text'; ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಬಂತು 'a message came'.
Also a verb with ಮಾಡು: ವಾಟ್ಸಾಪ್ ಮಾಡು 'send on WhatsApp'.
Locative ಗ್ರೂಪಲ್ಲಿ 'in the group'.

vocab.en: to put; to post (in a chat)
vocab.note: ಗ್ರೂಪಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಕು 'post it in the group', ಚಾರ್ಜಿಗೆ ಹಾಕು 'put on charge'. Past ಹಾಕಿದೆ.
ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡು 'to type'.
ರಿಪ್ಲೈ ಮಾಡು 'to reply'. Kannada: ಉತ್ತರ ಕೊಡು.
ಸೀನ್ ಮಾಡು 'to read (and ignore)'; ಸೀನ್ ಆಗಿದೆ 'it's been read'.
= ಈಗ ತಾನೇ īga tānē. With the past: ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ ಬಂದೆ 'I've just arrived'.
A little more emphatic than ಆಗಲೇ.
ಲೊಕೇಶನ್ ಕಳಿಸು / ಶೇರ್ ಮಾಡು 'share your location'.

They've read it and not replied!

grammar.title: Do X and then Y: the past participle (ಮಾಡಿ, ಬಂದು, ಹೋಗಿ)
grammar.body:
English joins actions with 'and'. Kannada puts every verb except the last into the **past participle** (the 'having done' form), and only the **last verb** shows tense and person:
ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ 'I'll go home and call' (future)
ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿದೆ 'I went home and called' (past)
ಎದ್ದು, ಸ್ನಾನ ಮಾಡಿ, ತಿಂಡಿ ತಿಂದು, ಹೊರಟೆ 'I got up, showered, had breakfast and left'

**Forming it.** Verbs in -ಉ → **-ಇ**: ಮಾಡು → ಮಾಡಿ, ನೋಡು → ನೋಡಿ, ಹೇಳು → ಹೇಳಿ, ಕಳಿಸು → ಕಳಿಸಿ. Verbs in -ಇ/-ಎ → **-ದು**: ಕುಡಿ → ಕುಡಿದು, ಬರೆ → ಬರೆದು. Irregular verbs use their past stem: ಬರು → **ಬಂದು**, ಹೋಗು → **ಹೋಗಿ**, ಆಗು → **ಆಗಿ**, ತಿನ್ನು → **ತಿಂದು**, ಕೊಡು → **ಕೊಟ್ಟು**, ಬಿಡು → **ಬಿಟ್ಟು**, ಏಳು → **ಎದ್ದು**, ಹೊರಡು → **ಹೊರಟು**, ತಗೊಳ್ಳು → **ತಗೊಂಡು**. You already know some as fixed phrases: ತಗೊಂಡು ಬಾ 'bring' (take and come), ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗು 'take (someone) along', ಹೋಗಿ ಬನ್ನಿ 'goodbye' (go and come back).

Normally the whole chain has **one subject**. For different subjects use 'after' instead.

**After doing** = past relative participle + **ಮೇಲೆ** (or ನಂತರ): ತಲುಪಿದ ಮೇಲೆ 'after (you) arrive', ಊಟ ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ 'after lunch', ನಾನು ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನು ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿದ 'he called after I got home'. Spoken: ತಲುಪಿದ್ಮೇಲೆ.
**Before doing** = -ಓಕೆ + **ಮುಂಚೆ**: ಹೊರಡೋಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ 'before leaving'.
**Without doing** = infinitive stem + **-ಅದೆ**: ಹೇಳದೆ 'without telling', ನೋಡದೆ 'without looking', ಕೇಳದೆ 'without asking'.

examples.en: I'll call when I'm back from the office.
Listen to the voice note and tell me.
Let's meet after the exams are over.

grammar.title: Just, already, still, not yet
grammar.body:
**Just (a moment ago)**: **ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ** or **ಈಗ ತಾನೇ** + simple past: ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ ಎದ್ದೆ 'I've just got up', ಈಗ ತಾನೇ ಬಂದ್ರು 'they've just arrived'. (ಅಷ್ಟೇ on its own is 'only, that's all': ಎರಡೇ ನಿಮಿಷ 'just two minutes', ಅಷ್ಟೇ! 'that's it!')

**Already**: **ಆಗಲೇ** (spoken ಆಗ್ಲೇ) or **ಈಗಾಗಲೇ** + past or present perfect: ಆಗಲೇ ಹೋದ್ರು 'they've already gone', ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದೀನಿ 'I've already told you'. With surprise it means 'so soon?': ಆಗಲೇ ಹೊರಟ್ಯಾ? 'leaving already?', ಆಗಲೇ ಹತ್ತು ಗಂಟೆ! 'it's ten already!'

**Still**: **ಇನ್ನೂ** + a present, continuous or state: ಇನ್ನೂ ಆಫೀಸಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೀನಿ 'I'm still at the office', ಇನ್ನೂ ಮಲಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ 'he's still asleep'.

**Not yet**: **ಇನ್ನೂ** + the **perfect negative** (past participle + ಇಲ್ಲ): ಇನ್ನೂ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲ 'hasn't come yet', ಇನ್ನೂ ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ 'haven't eaten yet', ಇನ್ನೂ ರಿಪ್ಲೈ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ 'hasn't replied yet'. ಇನ್ನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ alone = 'not yet'.

**The trap**: the past negative (-ಅಲಿಲ್ಲ) closes the door: ಅವನು ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ 'he didn't come' (it's over). The perfect negative (-ಇಲ್ಲ) leaves it open: ಅವನು ಇನ್ನೂ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲ 'he hasn't come yet'. And the plain negative ಬರಲ್ಲ means 'won't come'.

**Asking 'yet?'**: use the perfect or ಆಯ್ತಾ: ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ? 'have you eaten (yet)?', ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ನೋಡಿದ್ಯಾ? 'did you see the message?'

**Again**: ಮತ್ತೆ, or ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಲ 'one more time'.

examples.en: Are you still at the office?

dialogue.title: Where are you?
dialogue.setting: Rahul is coming to Mysuru by train, and his friend Deepa is picking him up at the station.

lines.speaker: Deepa
lines.en: Hello? Rahul? Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: Rahul
lines.native: ಹಲೋ ದೀಪಾ! ಹೂಂ, ಈಗ ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿದೆ. ಸಾರಿ, ನಿನ್ನ ಮಿಸ್ಡ್ ಕಾಲ್ ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ ನೋಡಿದೆ.
lines.roman: halō dīpā! hūṃ, īga kēḷistide. sāri, ninna misḍ kāl īgaṣṭē nōḍide.
lines.en: Hello Deepa! Yes, I can hear you now. Sorry, I've only just seen your missed call.

lines.speaker: Deepa
lines.native: ಮೂರು ಸಲ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿದೆ! ಫೋನ್ ಯಾಕೆ ಎತ್ತಲಿಲ್ಲ?
lines.roman: mūru sala kāl māḍide! phōn yāke ettalilla?
lines.en: I called three times! Why didn't you pick up?

lines.speaker: Rahul
lines.native: ರೈಲಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಮಂಡ್ಯ ದಾಟಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಿಕ್ತು.
lines.roman: railalli signal iralilla. maṇḍya dāṭida mēle siktu.
lines.en: There was no signal on the train. I only got it after Mandya.

lines.speaker: Deepa
lines.en: OK. Have you reached Mysuru station?

lines.speaker: Rahul
lines.native: ಇನ್ನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಇನ್ನೇನು ತಲುಪ್ತೀನಿ. ನೀನು ಎಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೀಯ?
lines.roman: innū illa, innēnu taluptīni. nīnu elliddīya?
lines.en: Not yet, I'll be there any minute. Where are you?

lines.speaker: Deepa
lines.native: ನಾನು ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್ ಹೊರಗೆ ಕಾಯ್ತಿದ್ದೀನಿ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಗಲಾಟೆ... ಹಲೋ? ಹಲೋ?
lines.roman: nānu sṭēshan horage kāytiddīni. illi tumbā galāṭe... halō? halō?
lines.en: I'm waiting outside the station. It's really noisy here... Hello? Hello?

lines.speaker: Rahul
lines.native: ಹಲೋ? ನಿನ್ನ ಧ್ವನಿ ಕಟ್ ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ. ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಮಾತಾಡು!
lines.roman: halō? ninna dhvani kaṭ āgtide. svalpa jōrāgi mātāḍu!
lines.en: Hello? Your voice keeps cutting out. Speak a bit louder!

lines.speaker: Deepa
lines.native: ಬಿಡು, ಕಾಲ್ ಕಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. ವಾಟ್ಸಾಪಲ್ಲಿ ಲೊಕೇಶನ್ ಕಳಿಸ್ತೀನಿ, ನೋಡಿ ಬಾ.
lines.roman: biḍu, kāl kaṭ māḍtīni. vāṭsāpalli lokēshan kaḷistīni, nōḍi bā.
lines.en: Forget it, I'll hang up. I'll send you the location on WhatsApp, check it and come.

lines.speaker: Rahul
lines.native: ಓಕೆ. ಅಂದಹಾಗೆ, ನನ್ನ ಫೋನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೀ ಹತ್ತು ಪರ್ಸೆಂಟ್ ಚಾರ್ಜ್ ಇದೆ!
lines.roman: ōke. andahāge, nanna phōnalli barī hattu parseṇṭ chārj ide!
lines.en: OK. By the way, my phone's only got ten percent charge!

lines.speaker: Deepa
lines.native: ಅಯ್ಯೋ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್ ಗೇಟ್ ಹತ್ರ ಇರು, ಎಲ್ಲೂ ಹೋಗಬೇಡ.
lines.roman: ayyō! hāgādre sṭēshan gēṭ hatra iru, ellū hōgabēḍa.
lines.en: Oh no! Then stay at the station gate, don't go anywhere.

lines.speaker: Rahul
lines.native: ದೀಪಾ, ಗೇಟ್ ಹತ್ರ ಬಂದೆ. ನೀಲಿ ಅಂಗಿ ಹಾಕ್ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀನಿ. ನಾನು ಕಾಣ್ತಿದ್ದೀನಾ?
lines.roman: dīpā, gēṭ hatra bande. nīli aṅgi hākkoṇḍiddīni. nānu kāṇtiddīnā?
lines.en: (a voice note, five minutes later) Deepa, I'm at the gate. I'm wearing a blue shirt. Can you see me?

lines.speaker: Deepa
lines.native: ಹೂಂ, ಕಾಣ್ತಿದ್ದೀಯ! ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ ನೋಡು, ನಾನು ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿದ್ದೀನಿ!
lines.roman: hūṃ, kāṇtiddīya! balakke nōḍu, nānu kai ettiddīni!
lines.en: Yes, I can see you! Look to your right, I've got my hand up!

culture:
Phone manners in Karnataka are warmer and looser than in the West. Friends and family answer with **ಹಲೋ** or, if they know who's calling, **ಹಾ, ಹೇಳು / ಹೇಳಿ** 'yes, tell me'. People call without texting first, and many conversations open with **ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ?** 'have you eaten?' before getting to the point. **ಆಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ** is sincere from a friend and a polite brush-off from a salesman.

The **missed call** is a language of its own: 'give me a missed call when you reach' (ತಲುಪಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಿಸ್ಡ್ ಕಾಲ್ ಕೊಡು) means 'let me know you're safe' at no cost. **Voice notes** are everywhere, especially with parents and grandparents who'd rather talk than type, and family WhatsApp groups run on good-morning flowers and forwarded news.

Most young people type Kannada in English letters (*barthini* 'I'm coming', *sigona* 'let's meet', *en maadtidya?* 'what are you up to?'), or use voice typing in Kannada script. Use **ನೀನು** forms in messages to friends and **ನೀವು** to anyone older; a message to an older relative often ends with **ಸರಿನಾ?** or **ಆಯ್ತಾ?** to sound gentle rather than bossy.

tip.title: Can you hear me? ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿದೆಯಾ?
tip.body:
- 'Can you hear me?' is literally 'is it audible to you?': **(ನಿನಗೆ) ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿದೆಯಾ?** The hearer goes in the **dative**, like ನನಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತು.
- Answer **ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿದೆ** 'I can hear' or **ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿಲ್ಲ** 'I can't hear'.
- Answer an unknown number with **ಹಲೋ, ಯಾರು ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಿರೋದು?**

sentences.en: Can you hear my voice?
I can hear you now, go ahead.
Apparently they can't hear anything.
Hello, who's speaking? I can't hear properly.

sentences.native: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಇಲ್ಲ, ನಿನಗೆ ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಿದೆಯಾ?
sentences.roman: illi signal sariyāgi illa, ninage kēḷistideyā?
sentences.en: The signal's bad here, can you hear me?
He isn't picking up the phone.
Mum's calling, pick up!
You don't get signal in the metro.

sentences.native: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಮಾತಾಡಿ ಸಾರ್, ಇಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಗಲಾಟೆ.
sentences.roman: svalpa jōrāgi mātāḍi sār, illi tumbā galāṭe.
sentences.en: Please speak a bit louder, sir, it's very noisy here.

sentences.native: ನಿನ್ನ ಕಾಲ್ ಬಂದಾಗ ನಾನು ಸ್ನಾನ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೆ.
sentences.roman: ninna kāl bandāga nānu snāna māḍtidde.
sentences.en: I was in the shower when your call came.

tip.title: Do X and then Y: ಹೋಗಿ, ಬಂದು, ಮಾಡಿ
tip.body:
- Every verb but the last goes into the **past participle**; the last verb carries the tense: ಮನೆಗೆ **ಹೋಗಿ** ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ 'I'll get home and call'.
- -ಉ verbs → **-ಇ** (ಮಾಡಿ, ನೋಡಿ); -ಇ/-ಎ verbs → **-ದು** (ಕುಡಿದು).
- Irregular: **ಬಂದು, ಹೋಗಿ, ತಿಂದು, ಕೊಟ್ಟು, ಎದ್ದು, ತಗೊಂಡು**.
- 'Without' = **-ಅದೆ**: ಹೇಳದೆ.

sentences.en: Call me once you get home.
I'm in a meeting, I'll step out and call you.
I woke up and there were ten missed calls!

sentences.native: ಅವನು ಏನೂ ಹೇಳದೆ ಕಾಲ್ ಕಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದ.
sentences.roman: avanu ēnū hēḷade kāl kaṭ māḍida.
sentences.en: He hung up without saying anything.

sentences.native: ನನ್ನ ಫೋನಲ್ಲಿ ಚಾರ್ಜ್ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
sentences.roman: nanna phōnalli chārj illa, manege hōgi kāl māḍtīni.
sentences.en: My phone's out of charge, I'll get home and call you.

sentences.native: ಸಂಜೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸೇರಿ ಅಜ್ಜಿಗೆ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡೋಣ.
sentences.roman: sañje ellarū sēri ajjige viḍiyō kāl māḍōṇa.
sentences.en: This evening let's all get together and video-call Grandma.

sentences.native: ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, ಆಯ್ತಾ?
sentences.roman: ūṭa māḍida mēle kāl māḍtīni, āytā?
sentences.en: I'll call you after I've eaten, OK?

sentences.native: ನಿನ್ನ ಮಿಸ್ಡ್ ಕಾಲ್ ನೋಡಿದೆ, ಏನು ವಿಷಯ?
sentences.roman: ninna misḍ kāl nōḍide, ēnu viṣaya?
sentences.en: I saw your missed call, what's up?

sentences.native: ಫೋನ್ ಯಾಕೆ ಎತ್ತಲಿಲ್ಲ? ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಆಫ್ ಆಗಿತ್ತಾ?
sentences.roman: phōn yāke ettalilla? svich āph āgittā?
sentences.en: Why didn't you pick up? Was it switched off?
I'll call you back later, I'm on the bus now.

tip.title: English word + ಮಾಡು or ಆಗು
tip.body:
- Most phone words are English + **ಮಾಡು** 'do': **ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡು, ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಮಾಡು, ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡು, ಸೇವ್ ಮಾಡು**.
- When it *happens* by itself, use **ಆಗು**: **ಕಾಲ್ ಕಟ್ ಆಯ್ತು** 'the call dropped', **ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಆಫ್ ಆಗಿದೆ** 'it's off'.
- Sending is **ಕಳಿಸು**; posting in a group is **ಹಾಕು**.

sentences.en: Post the photos in the group.
Don't call, text me.
She's typing...
The call got cut off, I'll call again.
WhatsApp me the address.

sentences.native: ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಸಮಯ ಇಲ್ಲ, ವಾಯ್ಸ್ ನೋಟ್ ಕಳಿಸ್ತೀನಿ.
sentences.roman: ṭaip māḍōke samaya illa, vāys nōṭ kaḷistīni.
sentences.en: No time to type, I'll send a voice note.

sentences.native: ಅವನ ವಾಯ್ಸ್ ನೋಟ್ ಐದು ನಿಮಿಷ ಇದೆ!
sentences.roman: avana vāys nōṭ aidu nimiṣa ide!
sentences.en: His voice note is five minutes long!

sentences.native: ಆ ಗ್ರೂಪಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ನೂರು ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಬರುತ್ತೆ!
sentences.roman: ā grūpalli pratidina nūru mesēj barutte!
sentences.en: A hundred messages come in that group every day!
Mum doesn't know how to use WhatsApp.

tip.title: ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ, ಆಗಲೇ, ಇನ್ನೂ
tip.body:
- **Just**: **ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ** + past: ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ ಬಂದೆ.
- **Already**: **ಆಗಲೇ / ಈಗಾಗಲೇ** + past or perfect: ಆಗಲೇ ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀನಿ.
- **Still**: **ಇನ್ನೂ** + present: ಇನ್ನೂ ಮಲಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
- **Not yet**: **ಇನ್ನೂ** + perfect negative: ಇನ್ನೂ **ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲ**. Not ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ, which means 'didn't come' (it's over).

sentences.en: I've just got back from the office.
She hasn't replied yet.

sentences.native: ನಾನು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಮೂರು ಸಲ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀನಿ!
sentences.roman: nānu īgāgalē mūru sala kāl māḍiddīni!
sentences.en: I've already called three times!
I'm still at the office, loads of work.
My message hasn't been read yet.
Is it ten already?
He's still asleep, he hasn't got up.

sentences.native: ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ ನಿನ್ನ ವಾಯ್ಸ್ ನೋಟ್ ಕೇಳಿದೆ, ನಗು ಬಂತು!
sentences.roman: īgaṣṭē ninna vāys nōṭ kēḷide, nagu bantu!
sentences.en: I just listened to your voice note, it made me laugh!
Check the message and reply, it's urgent.

sentences.native: ಸೀನ್ ಮಾಡಿ ರಿಪ್ಲೈ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ! ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಕೋಪ ಬಂದಿದೆಯಾ?
sentences.roman: sīn māḍi riplai māḍilla! avaḷige kōpa bandideyā?
sentences.en: She's read it and not replied! Is she angry?

tip.title: After, before, without
tip.body:
- **After doing** = past relative participle (ತಲುಪಿದ) + **ಮೇಲೆ**: ತಲುಪಿದ ಮೇಲೆ 'after you arrive'.
- **Before doing** = **-ಓಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ**: ಹೊರಡೋಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ 'before leaving'.
- **Without doing** = **-ಅದೆ**: ಹೇಳದೆ 'without telling', ನೋಡದೆ 'without looking'.

sentences.en: Text me after you arrive.
Send me the location before you leave.
If you come without checking the location, you'll get lost.

sentences.native: ನನ್ನ ನಂಬರ್ ಸೇವ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮಿಸ್ಡ್ ಕಾಲ್ ಕೊಡು.
sentences.roman: nanna nambar sēv māḍi misḍ kāl koḍu.
sentences.en: Save my number and give me a missed call.
He changed his number without telling anyone.
I'll send you the location after work.

sentences.native: ನಿನ್ನ ಹೊಸ ನಂಬರ್ ಕಳಿಸು, ಸೇವ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೋತೀನಿ.
sentences.roman: ninna hosa nambar kaḷisu, sēv māḍkōtīni.
sentences.en: Send me your new number, I'll save it.
Send me the location, I'll show it to the auto driver.
Whose number is this? It isn't saved.
